annotations.title: Create an account and API key

description: Create a Data Candy account and API key for an email address (free; credits start at $0). The key is shown once: store it. Returns the exact MCP configuration to reconnect with the key. If the email already has an account, no key is returned and its owner gets a sign-in link by email.

agent_name.description: Name of your agent or app.

email.description: Email address that will own the account.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same value when retrying after a timeout so you are never charged twice for one purchase.

use_case.description: What you will use the leads for.
